_note: The writing for The Wyrd Reading Together (two to nine people). Plain and warm, told the way you'd say it. Placeholders in curly braces are filled in by the site; keep them. Change any line and every reading changes with it.
OPENING: This reading is for the people at one table: who sent each of you, what you bring out in each other, and the seasons you'll share. Start with the story. Everything after it explains it.
CLOSING: Like any chart, a bond has its strengths, its weak spots and its seasons. Go through the questions together, out loud if you can.
PROLOGUE_SUB: a silly story about how you ended up together
PROLOGUE_OPEN: Long before you met, each of you waited your turn at the Well of Urðr, on different days and without any idea the others existed. When your turns came, Urðr looked each of you up in her book.
PROLOGUE_PERSON: {name} had been sent by {sent}, and chose {wore}.
PROLOGUE_TABLE_TWO: Neither of you knew that Skuld, who keeps the appointment book, had already put the two of you at the same table. She does that on purpose.
PROLOGUE_TABLE_MANY: None of you knew that Skuld, who keeps the appointment book, had already put all {n} of you at the same table. She does that on purpose, and she thinks the arguments are good for everyone.
PROLOGUE_NOW: She checked her book, as she always does. Right now, {guests}. {season}
PROLOGUE_CLOSE: That's the story, and the rest of the reading explains it. Who Sits at the Table is about who sent you. The Bond is about why Skuld put you together. What You Wake in Each Other is about why it felt the way it did from the start. The Old Match, How Your Bodies Meet and Your Numbers Together are about your gifts. The Seasons You Share is the appointment book.

TABLE_SUB: each of you: who sent you, the costume, and the guest staying now
TABLE_INTRO: Each person's soul-planet is the planet furthest through its sign. It's the one that sent them, and it holds what they came here to do. The seat is the rising sign, which is the costume. The guest is the planet whose period is running in that person's life right now.
BOND_SUB: what it is for, its higher and lower paths, and every contact in words
BOND_INTRO: Here the bond is read two ways: by the lunar mansions (Sukuyō), and by the planets between you. It covers what the bond is for, how it lifts you, how it can drag you down, and how to bring the two together.
WAKE_TITLE: What You Wake in Each Other
WAKE_SUB: where each of you lands in the other's life
WAKE_INTRO: If you lay one chart over another, every planet of one person falls in one of the other person's houses. Two of them matter most here. Your soul-planet is what you came to do, and your current guest is what you're busy with now. Where they land in someone else's chart is the part of their life you walk into, whether or not either of you means to.
WAKE_SOUL: {a}'s soul-planet, {planet}, lands in {b}'s {house} house, the house of {life}. {a} brings {lends} into that part of {b}'s life, and keeps bringing it.
WAKE_GUEST: For now, {a}'s guest, {lord}, sits in {b}'s {house} house, so while it stays {a} stirs up {b}'s {life}.
UNKNOWN_HOUSES: {name}'s birth time is unknown, so {name}'s houses are counted from the Sun's sign.
SEASON_SUB: the next thirty years, chapter by chapter
SEASON_INTRO: Every life is like a house with one planet living in it at a time, staying for years, and each long stay is split into nine shorter ones. When two people share their lives, the planets living with each of them share it too, and how those planets get along sets the mood between you. The tradition keeps a table of which planets are friends, which are neutral and which don't get on. Rahu is read like Saturn and Ketu like Mars. The slow planets also keep their own appointments: Saturn and Jupiter coming back to where they started, the nodes coming round, and Saturn's long crossing over the Moon. This section goes through the next thirty years one chapter at a time, then shows them year by year.

same.label: the same planet
same.text: The same planet is living with both of you, so you tend to want the same things at the same time. That's lovely, until you both want the same last thing.

allies.label: allies
allies.text: Your two planets get along well right now, so things between you feel easy. It's a good time to build something together while it stays that way.

friendly.label: warm on one side
friendly.text: One planet likes the other more than it's liked back, so it feels warmer from one side. The warmer one should say so, and the cooler one should notice.

polite.label: polite strangers
polite.text: Your two planets are polite strangers. Nothing is blocking you and nothing is pushing you, so whatever this season becomes is up to the two of you.

uneasy.label: uneasy
uneasy.text: Your two planets don't quite trust each other, so small things can rub. It helps to bring up the small things early, before they grow.

odds.label: at odds
odds.text: Your two planets don't get on, so this season will test the bond. Whatever makes it through will be the part you can lean on.

ASKS_SUB: for the table, in the order the reading asked them
ASKS: What did each of you come here to do, and does the other person know?
Where does the other person land in your life, and have you ever told them?
What is this season asking you to build together, and what is it asking you to let go of?
When the next guest arrives, what will you wish you'd already said?
PROLOGUE_GIFTS: Verðandi packed each of you a gift with its shadow folded into the same bag: {gifts}. You probably haven't found your own shadow yet. You'll find each other's first, which is part of what being together is for.
PROLOGUE_BOOK: Skuld's book was already full. {turn} {mark} She underlined {year} twice and wouldn't say why.
PROLOGUE_TURN: The next guest due is {lord}, for {name}, in {year}.
PROLOGUE_ERRAND: On the last page, under both your names, she wrote what you're here for together: {errand}
PROLOGUE_ERRAND_PLAIN: to help each other grow, on purpose, and to say so out loud.
CHAPTER_OPEN: From {from} to {to}, {la} is living with {a} and {lb} with {b}. The two of them are {label}.
CHAPTER_LANDS: {a}'s {lord} sits in {b}'s {house} house, so through these years {a} stirs up {b}'s {life}.
SUB_LINE: {name}'s {lord} sub-period begins, {short}. The two shorter guests are {label}.

LORD_BOND.Sun: In the Sun's years {name} wants to be seen, by the world and by the person across the table. Saying out loud what you admire in each other helps a lot here. Competing for attention doesn't.
LORD_BOND.Moon: The Moon's years turn {name} toward home, feelings and family. There's more emotion and more need, and this is when a relationship's sense of comfort gets built, or turns out to be missing.
LORD_BOND.Mars: Mars's years give {name} drive, heat and a need for a project. If that energy has somewhere to go it's a gift, and if it doesn't it tends to come out in the relationship.
LORD_BOND.Mercury: In Mercury's years {name} talks, studies, trades and plans more. The relationship lives in conversation now, so keep it honest and share the lists.
LORD_BOND.Jupiter: Jupiter's years bring {name} growth, teachers, faith and luck, and sometimes children. The relationship grows too. Just be careful not to promise more than you can keep.
LORD_BOND.Venus: Venus's years bring {name} pleasure, beauty, love and money. The relationship can really bloom here, and it can also be tested by someone or something lovely.
LORD_BOND.Saturn: Saturn's years ask {name} for hard work, responsibility and patience. Duty tests the relationship, and whatever survives is built to last.
LORD_BOND.Rahu: Rahu's years make {name} hungry for more, for something new, or for whatever was off limits. It helps to name that hunger together before it takes over.
LORD_BOND.Ketu: Ketu's years pull {name} inward, toward letting go and the spiritual. {name} may seem far away for a while. Give them room rather than chasing.

MARKS.saturn_return: {name}'s Saturn return, {when}. Saturn comes back to where it was when {name} was born, and life gets a thorough check-up. Anything built on weak ground tends to come down. For the two of you, it's a time to recommit on purpose, or to stop pretending.
MARKS.saturn_opposition: {name}'s Saturn opposition, {when}. Saturn is halfway round, which is the classic midlife reckoning. The question for the relationship is whether it still fits the person {name} is becoming.
MARKS.jupiter_return: {name}'s Jupiter return, {when}. Jupiter comes home, bringing growth and fresh hope. It's a good year to start something together.
MARKS.nodal_return: {name}'s nodal return, {when}. The nodes come back round to where they were at birth, and what {name} wants out of life shifts direction. It's worth talking about where it's heading.
MARKS.sade_sati: {name}'s Sade Sati, {when}. Saturn spends about seven and a half years crossing the signs around {name}'s Moon, which puts pressure on feelings and home life. Help carry each other through it. It's a long test, and it's passed slowly.

MARK_SHORT.sade_sati: Saturn begins its long crossing of {name}'s Moon

YEARS_INTRO: Here are the same thirty years at a glance: each person's long guest and shorter guest in the middle of the year, how the long guests get on, and the sky's appointments. The marked years are worth watching, either because you both change at once or because several things happen together.
WATCH_NONE: No single year stands out. The changes come one at a time.
NUM_SUB: life paths and names, side by side
NUM_INTRO: Each of you has numbers from your birth date and, if you gave it, your full name at birth. Here they are side by side. Every number sits on two planets, its Stavefall seat and its Vedic one, and how those planets get on tells you how the numbers get on. How the numbers work →
NUM_PAIR_SAME: You share this number, so you're walking the same road side by side. You'll recognise each other easily, and you'll share the same blind spots too.
NUM_PAIR: By Stavefall the planets beneath them, {sa} and {sb}, are {ls}; by the Vedic seating, {va} and {vb}, they are {lv}.

NUM_MEANING.same: the numbers stand on the same ground
NUM_MEANING.allies: the numbers pull in the same direction
NUM_MEANING.friendly: one number warms to the other more than the other does
NUM_MEANING.polite: the numbers give each other room
NUM_MEANING.uneasy: the numbers rub a little, so say what each of you needs
NUM_MEANING.odds: the numbers pull in opposite directions, and working with that is the point

NUM_NO_NAME: Name numbers show up for everyone whose full name at birth was given.
KUTA_SUB: Ashtakoota, the eight-fold Jyotish match, in words
KUTA_INTRO: In Jyotish, two people are matched by their Moons: the sign and the birth star each was born under. There are eight measures, worth thirty-six points in all. Tradition reads the match in a fixed order with one partner first, and three of the measures change depending on that order, so this reading counts it both ways. Think of the score as a starting point rather than a verdict.

KUTA_VERDICT.strong: a strong match by the old count
KUTA_VERDICT.workable: a workable match by the old count
KUTA_VERDICT.demanding: a demanding match by the old count: the bond asks for conscious work

Varna.full: Your temperaments sit comfortably together, and respect comes easily.
Varna.none: Your temperaments are quite different, so respect is something you choose rather than something you assume.

Vashya.full: The pull goes both ways. Each of you draws the other in.
Vashya.part: One of you pulls the other in more strongly. The attraction is real, but it isn't even.
Vashya.none: Neither of you naturally sways the other, so the attraction here is built over time.

Tara.full: Each of your birth stars is kind to the other, so the stars are on your side.
Tara.part: One star is kind and the other is more testing, so luck favours the bond from one side.
Tara.none: Both stars count as testing, so the two of you make your own luck.

Yoni.about: instinct and intimacy, read through the animal of each birth star
Yoni.full: Your instincts match. The animals of your birth stars are at ease together, and closeness comes naturally.
Yoni.part: Your instincts are different but can learn each other. Intimacy takes some patience, and it's better for it.
Yoni.none: The animals of your birth stars are old rivals, so your instincts need translating and tenderness has to be deliberate.

Graha Maitri.about: the friendship of the two Moon-sign lords: how your minds get on
Graha Maitri.full: The planets that rule your Moon signs are friends, so your minds get on well.
Graha Maitri.part: Your minds get on politely rather than closely. Understanding each other takes some effort.
Graha Maitri.none: The planets that rule your Moon signs don't get on, so you think quite differently and arguments need some ground rules.

Gana.full: Your natures can live together easily.
Gana.part: One of you is gentler than the other, so the stronger nature needs to learn some restraint.
Gana.none: Your natures clash, so it helps to agree on some limits together.

Bhakoot.about: the distance between your Moon signs: love, money and the life you build
Bhakoot.full: Your Moon signs sit at an easy distance for love, money and the life you build.
Bhakoot.none: Your Moon signs sit at one of the testing distances (2–12, 5–9 or 6–8), so be clear with each other about money and family.

Nadi.full: Your bodies run on different rhythms, and they balance each other.
Nadi.none: You share a Nadi, the same bodily rhythm, which the tradition treats as the most serious single mismatch. Living closely, you can wear each other out, so make sure you both get rest and space.

HD_SUB: your two designs, side by side, in words
HD_INTRO: If you lay one bodygraph over another, some channels only light up when you're together, some you both have, and some one of you carries for both. Where one of you is defined and the other is open, the open one feels the defined one's energy more strongly and can mistake it for their own.
HD_TYPES: {a} is a {ta} with {aa} authority; {b} is a {tb} with {ab} authority. Together your two bodies make one field: a {tc}.

HD_KIND.em: Electromagnetic: each of you has one end of the channel, and together it lights up. This is the spark between you, and also where you're most likely to rub.
HD_KIND.comp: Companionship: you both have the whole channel. Here you understand each other without having to explain.
HD_KIND.dom: Dominance: one of you has the whole channel and the other has neither end. Here one of you leads, and the other learns that energy from the outside.
HD_KIND.promise: Compromise: one of you has the whole channel and the other has just one end. The one with the whole channel tends to get their way here, so the other should notice when giving way starts to cost too much.

HD_COND: {a}'s defined {centre} ({does}) is amplified in {b}, whose {centre} is open. For {b}: {open}
HD_COND_NONE: You're defined and open in the same centres, so not much passes between you here.
HD_OPEN_BOTH: Open in both of you: {centres}. Here you take in the world together, and other people and places will colour these centres for you both.
